versions.summary: Layout corrected from Google Earth. Wooden fence, back alley, neighboring buildings and the billboard added.

Building and neighbors reshaped from Google Earth and the videos. Kitchen double door, hidden service corridor and restroom route placed as Robert describes. Existing landscaping added. Billboard removed.
Tables and chairs restyled like Bacari's LA patios: walnut tables on black iron bases, rattan bistro chairs, navy banquettes with bright pillows, rattan-back bar stools.
Rattan bistro bar stools with footrests and hoop backs, 12 more two-tops with clear staff aisles, and the two brown-topped trees made green.
Straight backs on all chairs and bar stools, and a glass double door on the upper floor opening onto the deck.
Front gate on W 6th drawn partly open so it reads as a door, and banquette back cushions in Bacari LA style bright prints over grey-striped seats.
Decks and their stairs drawn as real wood boards with wood fascia edges, and a more ornate street gate with lantern pillars, an iron arch and iron-and-wood leaves.
Eleven two-tops turned into four-tops across the decks, front terrace and garden, keeping clear staff aisles.
More planters throughout: olive and boxwood planters at the deck corners and by the gate and steps, hanging troughs on the upper deck railing, and a planted trough along the W 6th retaining wall.
